name: bto-cv
description: Convert original CVs into editable BTO Word documents and organize candidates in the Trello Talent Pool using the shared converter.

interface.shortDescription: BTO Word CVs and Trello candidate cards.
defaultPrompt: Convert the attached original CV into an editable BTO Word document.
Create a fictional BTO Word CV to test the formatting and native bullet lists.
Add the attached CV to the Talent Pool, create its BTO Word CV, and attach both CVs to the candidate card.
interface.longDescription: Create an editable .docx using the BTO reference banner, Century Gothic fonts, measured spacing and native square bullet lists. Preserves supplied facts. Includes a deterministic Word generator and optional HTML preview. When requested, create and organize Talent Pool candidate cards using the same converter, with both original and BTO CV attachments. Requires Trello access; attachment uploads and client copies may require an authenticated browser session.
